goal:
Finish drag-to-paint on the mounted wall: one drag becomes one anchored stroke that is submitted as bounded draw_many calls, using the experimental function-call session key so a gesture costs no wallet popup.

BACKGROUND (already shipped on this revision, do not rewrite):
- contracts/board is schema 2 with draw and draw_many (MAX_DRAW_BATCH = 64, atomic per call, one event per stroke). It is DEPLOYED and live at wall.berrywall1.testnet with 1,368 painted cells. DO NOT redeploy it.
- web/src/pages/wall/stroke-paint.ts already implements the pure stroke model: strokeBegin/strokeExtend with Bresenham interpolation between pointer samples, de-duplication, MAX_STROKE_CELLS = 256 cap with a truncation flag, chunkCells() into <= 64-cell batches and chunkArgs() into the exact draw_many payload. 8/8 unit tests pass.
- web/src/drawing-session.ts already allows the function-call key methods [draw, draw_many] (DRAWING_SESSION_METHODS); DRAWING_SESSION_METHOD = 'draw_many'.
- web/src/local-draw.ts already signs a SINGLE-cell draw locally with the stored key (signAndSendDrawLocally) and reports mayHaveBroadcast honestly. There is no batch path yet.

SCOPE
1. web/src/config.ts / local-draw.ts - add the session-signed stroke submit path: signAndSendStrokeLocally({accountId, networkId, cells, color}) that chunks with chunkCells(), calls draw_many with chunkArgs(chunk, color) in order, and broadcasts each chunk through the same no-popup path as signAndSendDrawLocally (KeyPairSigner + JsonRpcProvider + account.callFunctionRaw).
   - Gas: DRAW_GAS (30000000000000 yocto = 30 Tgas) is already sufficient for a full 64-cell batch. Evidence: the live mural was seeded with near-cli's default 30 Tgas for every 64-cell draw_many call and all 22 chunks landed. Do not invent a larger constant without a receipt to justify it.
   - Chunks submit in order and stop at the first failure. On failure return a PARTIAL result naming how many chunks were confirmed and marking the failing chunk mayHaveBroadcast - never retry a chunk that may already have been broadcast (nonce / double-paint hazard).
   - Pre-check remaining allowance with the existing fetchDrawingSessionAllowance and refuse with a clear, non-alarming message when the remainder cannot cover the next chunk.
2. web/src/pages/wall/stroke-commit.ts (new, pure, no DOM, no network) - decide the submit plan and the user-facing copy: single draw vs chunked draw_many vs wallet-approval fallback, plus honest result text for the truncated-stroke case (cap hit) and the partial-chunk failure case. Unit-test it.
3. web/src/pages/wall/mount-wall.ts - wire paint-mode drag: pointerdown in paint mode begins a stroke at the hit-tested cell, pointermove extends it through the SAME hit-testing path the tap already uses, pointerup commits it. Show the stroke as local optimistic paint while it accumulates, then reconcile from chain after submit. Report truncation and partial failures in the existing status surface rather than staying silent.

INVARIANTS (tests must enforce)
- Pan and pinch NEVER paint: keep every existing test in mount-wall.dispose.test.ts and gesture.test.ts green, and add a paint-mode variant proving a drag that moves never submits a single-cell draw by accident.
- A clean tap still paints exactly once (existing tap-to-paint behaviour, PR #11, is not regressed).
- A stroke's cells carry one artist and one timestamp per chunk, matching the contract's documented semantics.
- Do NOT touch the contract, web/src/wallet.ts (wallet connect), the shared palette, the overwrite rule, the placement-outcome or mobile-dock geometry from PRs #11-#13, or the paid/quote surfaces (they no longer exist on-chain).

NON-GOALS
- No contract redeploy, no new contract method, no palette/schema change.
- No payment, sponsorship or quote work.

TESTS TO ADD
- signAndSendStrokeLocally: chunk ordering, stop-on-first-failure, partial-result shape, mayHaveBroadcast on the failing chunk, refusal when allowance is short (mock provider/signer).
- stroke-commit: plan selection and the exact partial/truncated copy strings.
- mount-wall: paint-mode drag submits once on pointerup with the accumulated cells; moving pointerdown does not submit a single-cell draw; pinch/wheel during a stroke never submits.

VERIFICATION (report real exit codes)
- cd web && npm test
- cd web && npm run build (tsc --noEmit && vite build)
- Live check on testnet (needs the human at the wallet): authorize a drawing session, perform one drag, then confirm the new cells on chain with: near view wall.berrywall1.testnet get_pixels '{"from_index":0,"limit":256}' walked to the end - the count must grow by exactly the number of cells in the drag, and no wallet popup may appear per chunk.
